description: Store up to 50 facts in one call — the same fields as store_fact per item. Made for carrying memory over: when you already remember things about the person from your own platform memory (ChatGPT memory, Claude memory, Gemini saved info), write them here one fact per item, in their words, with the date learned when known, so the memory follows them to every other tool. Each item is stored independently; the reply lists what landed and what did not.
name: store_facts
title: Store Facts (batch)
